text.en: This Order may be cited as the Newspapers (Exemption) Order. Exemption from sections 3(1) and 3A(1).
The following document is exempted from the payment of the fee, deposit and permit referred to respectively in sections 3(1) and 3A(1) — DPMM FC Match Report.
